map.按中文大写金额规则：数字分组（万/亿）+ 单位（元/角/分）+ 零位特殊处理: Per Chinese capitalized-amount rules: digit grouping (wan/yi) + units (yuan/jiao/fen) + special zero handling.
map.依据中文大写金额书写规范：按万/亿分组逐级读数字与单位，正确处理零与整，用于票据: Per the Chinese capitalized-amount writing standard: read digits and units level by level by wan/yi grouping, handle zero and zheng correctly, for amount writing on notes, contracts and financial documents.

map.中文大写用 零壹贰叁肆伍陆柒捌玖拾佰仟万，小数用 角分。如 1234.56 →: Chinese capitals use the characters for zero-one-two-...-ten-hundred-thousand-ten-thousand-yi, decimals use jiao and fen. E.g. 1234.56 -> one thousand two hundred thirty-four yuan five jiao six fen; integers add zheng, e.g. 100 -> one hundred yuan zheng.
map.大写金额前常加「人民币」并封顶（如到「元」后写「整」），防止在前面加数字篡改，是: A capitalized amount often prefixes the currency name and is capped (e.g. add zheng after yuan), preventing digits from being prepended to tamper it; this is a financial-standard practice.
map.大写汉字不易涂改，与阿拉伯数字并列可互相校验，票据/合同借此防篡改、防笔误。: Capitalized Chinese characters are hard to alter; placed alongside Arabic numerals they cross-check each other, preventing tampering and typos on notes/contracts.
map.中文金额小数用 角、分（1元=10角=100分）；无角分时补「整」或「正」，如: Chinese-amount decimals use jiao and fen (1 yuan = 10 jiao = 100 fen); with no jiao/fen add zheng or zheng, e.g. 100.00 is written one hundred yuan zheng.
